'''Nathaniel Camaran'''<ref name="RG">{{InsiderCite|145|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Naboo's Finest!}}</ref> was a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo]] [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded Naboo, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Camaran quickly became one of the leaders of the [[Naboo Resistance]]. Camaran was in charge of security for a particular cell of the Resistance. The Lieutenant attended a meeting with [[Mett Habble/Legends|Mett Habble]] and [[Oti Trinta]] to convince several capable passengers from the [[Crescent (freighter)|''Crescent'']] to join the Resistance.<ref name="PoN" />

At some point, he received a promotion to [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="RG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camaran was a minor character in ''[[Peril on Naboo]]'', a three part campaign in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'' released in [[2001]]. Within the text, he is identified as a Lieutenant.<ref name="PoN" /> Later, in [[2013]], the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: Naboo's Finest!'']] article in [[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]] identified an extra from [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] as "Captain Nathaniel Camaran," providing an image, first name, and rank for the Security Guard.<ref name="RG" />
